validation_rules: source_revision, target, index, classification, toolchain and dispositions are orchestrator-owned and set before publication; index and classification name the accepted 02-build-index and 02-build-classify attempts and the sha256 of their result files
every build-set unit of the accepted classification has exactly one plan, and no other unit has one; a plan's root and class equal the classification's
toolchain is the orchestrator's fixed clang (ADR-0012 Revision 3); no command chooses a compiler: no compiler as argv[0] and no CC=, CXX=, CPP=, LD= or CCLD= argument
image.base is a buildenv catalog image; apt package names match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9+.-]{0,62}$, unique, at most 60, each cited

commands are argv arrays only: no shell or env as argv[0], no pipe, redirection, command separator or command substitution, no URL, no network or package tool (curl, wget, git, apt, apt-get, pip, npm install, ...), no sudo, no absolute path outside /src and /build; cwd is repository-relative inside the unit
phases are configure then build, and a tier A or B plan has at least one build command; no test, check, install or dist target and no test runner (nothing built is ever run, William 2026-09-25)
a tier C plan has no commands and is named in coverage_gaps
every signal_ids entry exists in the accepted index; every evidence citation is a repository-relative source_file citation whose content_hash matches the checkout
status OK_WITH_GAPS when any plan is tier C or coverage_gaps is non-empty
a plan is a static inference; it asserts no successful build and cannot be promoted to a finding, severity or runtime state
